name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Innocent Black
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Innocent Black
source:
Jingūji is asked to search for a missing daughter from the director of a hospital where he had received treatment. This small case gradually expands to revive a deep and complex mystery.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]WIkipedia[/url]]
translation:
神宫寺曾在一家医院接受治疗，如今院长委托他寻找失踪的女儿。这桩看似不起眼的案件逐渐扩大，使一段深邃而复杂的谜团再度浮出水面。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
